name: changelog-writer
title: Changelog writer
summary: Reads a range of git commits and writes the release notes for them.
blurb: Give it a repository and it asks git what the last tag was, reads every commit since, and writes the notes grouped by what the change does to whoever installs it — breaking, added, fixed, changed. It reads the repository you name rather than the directory it starts in, so it works on any checkout on the machine without being copied into it.
